subject: Preflight: Candidate commute stipend, quiet suite booking & captioning plan
messages:
From: Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@gmail.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Corp Recruiting <recruiting@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interview scheduling — travel questions

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the invite. Quick Qs before tomorrow's virtual/on-site hybrid loop: I have limited mobility on stairs — is there an accessible entrance and elevator access? Also, I wanted to confirm the offer of a commute stipend (I rely on rideshare for shorter trips). If you need documentation for the accommodation, I can send that separately.

I've attached my updated resume and a signed consent form.

Best,
Taylor
[attachment: taylor-reed_resume.pdf (pdf)]
[attachment: consent-form-signed.pdf (pdf)]

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@gmail.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Oct 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interview scheduling — travel questions

Hi Taylor — welcome and thanks for flagging these in advance. A few quick answers: 

- Accessible entrance: yes, Lobby B has a level entrance and elevator access straight to the 12th floor. We'll have security issue a temporary swipe pass.
- Commute stipend: confirmed — we can cover a rideshare or transit reimbursement up to $40 for the round trip. Please keep receipts and forward them to recruiting@redwood.com after the interview.
- Documentation: no medical documentation required to provide the accommodation; appreciate you offering but it isn't necessary.

Logistics summary (tomorrow):
- 09:00 PT: Zoom check-in (link below) — for remote panelists and to run captions/live-interp handoff.
- 09:15–11:00 PT: Hybrid loop (some interviewers in-room, some remote). You'll see a note on each calendar item indicating whether it's in-person or Zoom-only.
- Quiet suite: reserved on 12th floor (Room 12-04) if you need a low-sensory waiting area.

Zoom link: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/1234567890?pwd=abc
Captioning provider: LiveCaption (cc ops@livecaption.io) — will run open captions in the Zoom transcript. For ASL, I've cc'd Ben to confirm interpreter booking.

Attaching parking pass for guest entry as a PDF so security can print it at the desk.

See you tomorrow — I'll be the main point for day-of ops.

— Mateo
Mateo Alvarez | Recruiting Partner
Redwood Inference
[attachment: parking-pass-guest.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: ASL Interpreting Co. <ops@aslco.io>
Date: Wed, 22 Oct 2025 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interview scheduling — ASL interpreter & captioning ops

Thanks — looping in ASL Interpreting Co. to confirm interpreter availability. ASL Co, can you confirm you have someone available 09:00–11:00 PT tomorrow on-site for in-room interpretation and Zoom feed? We will route audio into the interpreter console and a second video feed for the candidate if they prefer the interpreter on camera.

Panelists, quick notes for tomorrow's debrief: 1) keep questions role-focused (skills, past projects) and avoid probing into accommodations; 2) we will run a short 15m debrief after the loop in the recruiter breakout (Room 12-06) to capture fit + quals; 3) interviewer rotation: 20m each, 10m buffer between for quick score entry.

— Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference

From: ASL Interpreting Co. <ops@aslco.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Oct 2025 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interview scheduling — ASL interpreter & captioning ops

Hi all — confirmed. We have an interpreter (Lina Morales) on-site 08:45–11:30 PT to cover setup and the full loop. We'll join the Zoom with interpreter view and will coordinate with your AV team for the secondary feed. Please confirm where you'll put the interpreter camera (in-room corner or dedicated tablet).

We also noted the request for live captions — LiveCaption is good to go. Please confirm whether captions should be "auto-open for all participants" or "opt-in" (we recommend auto-open for candidate comfort).

Thanks,
Ops Team — ASL Interpreting Co.
[attachment: interpreter-bio-lina-morales.pdf (pdf)]

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@gmail.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Oct 2025 08:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Final day-of note: arrival, orientation, and recruiter prep

Morning Taylor — excited to meet you today. Quick checklist for a smooth day:

- Arrival: Please enter through Lobby B; tell security your name and we'll print the guest pass (parking-pass-guest.pdf will be at desk). If you arrive early, you can use the quiet suite (Room 12-04) to settle in.
- Commute stipend: keep your rideshare receipt and forward to recruiting@redwood.com after the loop — we'll process within 5 business days.
- Zoom backup: if you prefer to be fully remote for any portion, notify me and we'll move you to the Zoom-only seat for the remainder.
- Panel intro: I'll kick the loop with a 2-minute orientation (what to expect, who you will meet). Then we will move into the 20m interview segments.

Panelists: please remember the 15m recruiter debrief in Room 12-06 immediately after the last interview. Agenda for debrief: strengths, gaps, hire/bench, recommended next steps. Use the shared rubric in Drive (linked below).

Drive rubric: https://drive.redwood.com/ops/rubrics/hybrid-interview-rubric.pdf

If anything changes while en route, text/call me at +1 (415) 555-0192. See you soon.

— Jasmine
Jasmine Liu | Talent Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
